items.title: Fortaleza (CE) Services procurement · electronic competitive bidding (concorrência) · closes Dec 11 #90002
items.en_title: Fortaleza (CE) Services procurement · electronic competitive bidding (concorrência) · closes Dec 11 #90002
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Fortaleza (CE) is procuring professional or outsourced services through electronic competitive bidding (concorrência), with an estimated value of about R$ 597,264,424.41; proposals close Dec 11, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
